name: Fyxer
description: Inbox and meeting assistant with a hosted MCP server that lets Claude, ChatGPT or Codex search your email and meetings, pull transcripts and draft replies in your style.

skills.name: Search Email and Meetings
skills.description: Search across the user's emails, meetings and documents, for example to find action items from last week.

skills.name: Get Meeting Transcripts
skills.description: Find meetings by topic or attendee and return the full summary or speaker-labelled transcript.

skills.name: Draft Email Replies
skills.description: Write an email draft in the user's style that they can open in Gmail or Outlook to review and send.

skills.name: Look Up Contacts
skills.description: Look up a contact's full name and email address from the user's connected inbox.
